title: Feu nourri
player_copy_markdown:
**DI02 · Feu nourri — Rang 11**

*Vous concentrez votre feu sur une seule cible et l’accablez de tirs.*

**Effet actuel**

- Séquences de tir : **2**.
- Projectiles tirés avec cette arme : **2**.
- Dégâts par projectile : **18–22** (**90 %** de l’attaque).
- Précision par projectile : **90 % de votre précision habituelle**.

**Prochain rang — 12 · 1 point de compétence**

- Dégâts par projectile : **18–23** (**93 %** de l’attaque).

**Coût : 13 énergie + 2 munitions · Recharge : 4 tours.**
**Portée : celle de l’arme active.**

Chaque projectile peut toucher ou manquer sa cible.

Dégâts indiqués avant les défenses de la cible.

**Nécessite une arme à distance active.**
current_profile_status: illustrative_not_a_user_save; not a proposed universal weapon variance

current_profile.range_status: ordinary weapon range; no fictional numeric range assigned
current_profile.mode_profile_status: illustrative; actual weapon mode determines projectile and ammunition display

formulas.projectile_count: 2 * native projectile count of active firing mode
formulas.damage_per_projectile: floor(base damage * percent/100 * ranged attribute multiplier), once at end
formulas.accuracy_multiplier: 9/10 of ordinary accuracy score, not a fixed 90 percent hit chance
formulas.ammunition_cost: number of projectiles fired for compatible one-ammunition-per-projectile modes; timings and other weapon profiles pending

current_values.range: ordinary range of the active compatible weapon

next_values.range: ordinary range of the active compatible weapon

next_rank_display.damage_range_display: Both range endpoints displayed together; minimum unchanged.

active_weapon_requirement.incompatible_warning: Nécessite une arme à distance active.

unshown_rules_approval: Full damage/cost curves, exact accuracy-score/defense calculation, compatible weapon families and active modes, per-projectile defense resolution, random damage distribution, ammunition prepayment/refusal and early target death, interruptions, actor visibility, affixes and native-mode modifiers remain pending where not previously accepted. No fixed 90% hit chance assumed. The two fixed native firing sequences and their mode-dependent projectile/ammunition count are accepted.
visual_intention_approval: accepted_catalogue_intention_only: closely spaced impacts and repeated short weapon recoil
checks: Source document and revised DI02 block hashes verified.
Two fixed native firing sequences accepted; one-shot mode gives 2 projectiles/munitions, three-shot burst gives 6, independent of skill rank.
Same 18-22 illustrative per-projectile weapon base, Perception 10, Agility 10 and multiplier 451/400; current coefficient 90% gives 18-22, next 93% gives 18-23.
Learned 9 to 10, equipment +2, fixed active firing mode and other modifiers; next block only changed damage row.
Revised RP, displayed exact current/next values and conditions accepted by explicit user validation; unshown rules and native rendering remain pending.
No redundant functional paragraph, formula/table, rank breakdown or ordinary action-time reminder in tooltip.
Historical proposal kept; no runtime, artwork or animation integration.

Native burst replaced by skill-defined projectile count.
